integrity: Definitions, proof, numerical checker and review concern one conditional marked small-volume theorem; origin-location marks apply only to the zero cell.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension and d independent coordinate hyperplane families only; full exponent-vector convergence is weak rather than total variation. The two-term tail has unquantified lower order; independent priority verification is not performed.
title: Universal logarithmic shape and marked-volume laws for tiny Poisson cuboids
